create_split_inference_module: create a SplitInferenceModule that splits input tensors into chunks for memory-efficient inference
enable_free_noise: enable FreeNoise long video generation with context length, stride, and weighting scheme parameters
disable_free_noise: disable the FreeNoise sampling mechanism and restore original transformer blocks
enable_free_noise_split_inference: enable FreeNoise memory optimizations by wrapping UNet blocks with SplitInferenceModule
check_free_noise_enabled: check if FreeNoise is currently enabled on the pipeline via the free_noise_enabled property
